name: Fake harness
command: set -e; instr="$(cat)"; [ -n "$FAKE_LOGIN" ] || { echo "fake: no login in its environment" >&2; exit 3; }; for f in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do if tr "\000" " " < "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qF "$FAKE_LOGIN"; then echo "fake: the login is in an argv" >&2; exit 4; fi; done; if [ -e /home/voice/.ssh ] || grep -q "/home/voice/.ssh" /proc/mounts; then echo "fake: a home is mounted" >&2; exit 5; fi; [ "$(pwd)" = /work ] || { echo "fake: not in /work" >&2; exit 6; }; echo "fake: asked to $(printf "%s" "$instr" | tail -n 1)"; case "$instr" in *slow*) echo "fake: taking my time"; sleep 600;; *no-change*) echo "fake: nothing to change"; exit 0;; *give-up*) echo "fake: giving up" >&2; exit 7;; esac; echo "hello from the fake harness" > FAKE.md; case "$instr" in *leave-uncommitted*) echo "fake: left FAKE.md for voice to commit";; *) git add FAKE.md && git commit -q -m "fake: add FAKE.md" && echo "fake: committed FAKE.md";; esac; echo "Added FAKE.md"

login.describe: A test's login, from the vault.

preamble: A test of voice's attempt wrapper.
